assessment.governing_intent: Complete Issue #146 by proving or repairing the READY supply invariant so READY starvation remains visible to the Factory Director while actionable supply exists, using the specified isolated Producer and independent Verifier workflow without disturbing #125, #138, unrelated cards, or Wave 2 DAG scope.
implementation_unknowns: Whether the existing ancestor commit 921fdfbf3783bf73749fa3b7957fa2c88460560e already satisfies all #146 acceptance criteria on the admission baseline.
Where the Director input/host supply calculation, prepared BIU supply buffer logic, diagnostics, live installed Director adapter readback, and focused tests reside in the repository.
Which exact feature regression packs are applicable to #146 and how their passing receipts should be retained.
How to perform and record the running-engine readback of maxCycles: 3 and maxReplacementsPerPhase: 1 in the target environment.

Exact mechanics for publishing the candidate branch/SHA, obtaining the independent Verifier worktree findings, posting the native Agent Ready ASSESSED receipt, and reading back authoritative Project DONE state.
material_risks: The reused implementation may only partially satisfy the criteria, requiring a targeted repair rather than a no-change record.
Live adapter and running-engine readbacks introduce environment/process risk even if the code change is localized.
The mandated Producer/Verifier separation must be preserved; collapsing it could invalidate the acceptance process.
Accidental changes to #125, #138, unrelated issue/project state, or protected-branch/runtime state would violate explicit boundaries.
Diagnostics or retained objects could accidentally introduce unbounded growth if not inspected as requested.
assessment.next_action: Proceed with handoff for implementation: start from the stated admission baseline, inspect and exercise the existing 921fdfbf implementation, publish an exact candidate SHA with either a no-change record or localized repair, then run the specified independent verification and release/readback sequence.
assessment.rationale: READY is the controlling disposition because the supplied packet resolves material owner decisions: scope, authority, priority ordering, baseline, reuse policy, acceptance criteria, verification procedure, boundaries, and prohibited actions are all explicit. The remaining unknowns concern locating code, running tests, collecting receipts, and validating the existing implementation, which are normal engineering execution tasks. The work is cohesive around one issue and one invariant, and expected repair is bounded to Director supply calculation, diagnostics, and focused tests rather than independent product decisions.
assessment.summary: The task has clear owner intent, explicit boundaries, acceptance criteria, authority, baseline, candidate-reuse instruction, verification flow, release constraints, and prohibited actions. Remaining uncertainty is mainly implementation and execution research, not unresolved product or authority intent.
assessment.verification_assessment: Acceptance is observable: the exact candidate SHA must demonstrate that HOLD and CLARIFY do not count toward prepared depth, below-target buffer with actionable backlog keeps control required even when WIP is full, READY at zero cannot report healthy idle while actionable supply exists, diagnostics expose actual prepared depth/target/supply candidates, and focused regression tests pass. A fresh Verifier checking that same SHA in an independent worktree can produce one meaningful independent verdict, with feature regression receipts and live adapter readback as supporting observations rather than substitutes for verdict.
